I will rejoice in my God
My soul will not go down to Sheol
I will see my Holy One
I offer praise and sing with all my might
I sing of the Lord’s endless grace
His word dwells deep in my heart
I delight in the Lord’s love as in a spring breeze
I am one who has received grace
I have a God who loves me
He died for me and led me through the gate of eternal life
He awakened my sleeping soul
I am one who has received grace
I have a God who loves me
His steadfast love is higher than the heavens and deeper than the sea
